tldr: Mars in the 9th house: drive, energy, and assertion push into beliefs, travel, and meaning
body: Mars in the 9th house: drive, energy, and assertion push into beliefs, travel, and meaning. Gift: real force there. Watch: friction and impatience. With Mars in the 9th house, drive, assertion, desire, conflict, courage, heat, and the ability to act move through belief, faith, travel, higher learning, publishing, and meaning. This makes how you search for truth, widen your world, and live what you believe a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become initiative, courage, stamina, directness, and the power to move this area forward. Left unconscious, it can become impatience, defensiveness, conflict for its own sake, or burning through this area faster than it can stabilize.
gift: initiative, courage, stamina, directness, and the power to move this area forward expressed through wisdom and expansion.
challenge: impatience, defensiveness, conflict for its own sake, or burning through this area faster than it can stabilize concentrated in wisdom and expansion.
note: Merged with approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
